languageDescription: UI language for this interface. Agent content and data stay untranslated.
showStatusDotDesc: Show a status color dot (running/idle/…) on each sidebar agent row; off by default to keep the list static and quiet
showActivityLineDesc: In wide-sidebar mode, show a second line of the agent's activity; off by default
showTerminatedDesc: Show terminated agents (red status dot) in the sidebar; off shows only live agents
showWeekdayDesc: Show the weekday in timeline card timestamps (e.g. Mon 14:30)
timeModeDesc: The time shown at the right of each agent row
timelineMaxWidthDesc: Max width of the conversation column as a fraction of the viewport ({min}%–{max}%), capped at 1280px so ultra-wide screens stay readable. The composer stays 48px narrower. Default {def}% = 768px on a 1920px screen.
collapseDetailsDesc: A newly-toggled work block starts collapsed instead of open. Flipping this (or the header's Details chip) expands/collapses every work block at once
usageBarWidthDesc: Width of the collapsed context-usage bar at the bottom of the composer; the expanded breakdown panel is unaffected
awaitingReplyDesc: Show a red dot + count badge in the sidebar for agents awaiting reply; off by default — check the Fleet page when you want to know
confirmTerminateDesc: Show a confirmation dialog when terminating an agent
confirmRestartDesc: Show a confirmation dialog when restarting an agent
confirmForceKillDesc: Show a confirmation dialog when force-killing (kill / SIGKILL) an agent
